prayerExcerpt.en-US: The keenest joy we are capable of feeling consists in prostrating all our powers of mind and heart in humblest adoration before the majesty of God.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: A mais viva alegria que somos capazes de sentir consiste em prostrar todas as faculdades do espírito e do coração na mais humilde adoração diante da majestade de Deus.

meta.face: A Dane of about forty-two, strongly built, with a fair, weather-reddened complexion and a DIAMOND-SHAPED face — a narrowish forehead under the crown, VERY WIDE, high cheekbones, tapering to a firm, rounded chin; a short, straight nose with a slightly upturned tip; narrow, wide-set pale-blue eyes under straight, sandy brows; a full, wide mouth; thick, straight red-gold hair to the jaw; a short, full red-gold beard and moustache; a calm, resolute gaze to one side.
meta.basis: The forensic studies of his skeleton at Odense (Danish Wikipedia) found a right-handed warrior with a skull of a man of 39 to 55, and he was born about 1043, so about forty-two at his death; nothing of his face or colouring is recorded. The dress follows the twelfth-century painted column in the Church of the Nativity at Bethlehem that shows him crowned with a lance and a cross-marked shield; the book gives the church where he died. The fair colouring and diamond structure are our choice, kept apart from `wenceslaus` and `stephen_hungary`.
